# Documentation

## Documentation

- Not all information can be conveyed in code
- We need to tell other people how to use our projects
- And sometimes ourselves!
- Documentation covers anything outside of the code/metadata

## README

:::{.columns}

::::{.column width=50%}

&nbsp;

- Markdown file at the project root
- Should contain:
  - Description of project
  - Dependencies
  - Instructions on building/running
::::

::::{.column width=50%}
![](images/ftorch-readme.png)
::::
:::

## Licences

- Licences are necessary for reproducibility!
- They define how code can be used/reused
- Enforce openness of code and data
  - FOSS licenses eg. GPL, MIT, BSD, etc
- Many explanations of which licence to use exist (and I'm not a lawyer!)
  - [choosealicense.com](https://choosealicense.com/)

## Comments

- Comments in code are also another form of documentation
- Comments should:
  - Explain *why* the code is doing something
  - Give context that is external to the scope

## Docstrings

:::{.columns}

::::{.column width=50%}
- Docstrings are a description embedded in the definition of something
  - e.g. functions, classes
- Describe how to *use* something, rather than how it works
- Often standardised in a language
  - e.g. for Python [PEP257](https://peps.python.org/pep-0257/)
- There are various conventions for how to write/format them e.g. [numpy](https://numpydoc.readthedocs.io/en/latest/format.html)
::::
::::{.column width=50%}
```{.python}
def energy_balanced_temperature(emissivity, albedo):
    """
    The temperature of Earth assuming 0D energy balance model

    Parameters
    ----------
    emissivity: float
        Effective emissivity of the Earth
    albedo: float
        Effective albedo of the Earth

    Returns
    -------
    temperature: float
        Temperature of Earth's surface assuming 0D energy balance model [K]
    """
    return (SOLAR_CONSTANT * (1.0 - albedo) / (4.0 * emissivity * SIGMA))**0.25
```
::::
:::

## Generating Docs

- Use tools that generate docs from source code
- Single source of truth
- Comments/Docstrings embedded in code
- Reduce separation between code and docs
